text: 你本能地退到房子附近的掩护处。你转身想跑，却来不及了。你刚进门，约书亚便开枪，一发子弹打中你的后背。你感到子弹穿透身体，从另一侧射出。你倒在地上。
你伸手捂住伤口，难以置信地看着满是血的手。抬起头时，你发现约书亚正站在你上方。他举枪指向你。在那短暂而可怕的一刻，你以为自己的生命就要结束了，但阿米莉娅尖叫起来。约书亚低声咒骂，一脚踢在你的脸上。你失去了意识。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 155
text: Instinctively, you retreat toward the cover of the house. You turn to run, but you aren’t quick enough. As you enter the doorway, Joshua fires his gun and you take a bullet in the back. You feel it tear through you and see the projectile pass out the other side. You collapse to the floor.

You reach down to clutch your wound, staring at your bloody hand in disbelief. You look up to find Joshua standing over you. He raises his gun at you. For a brief and terrible moment, you anticipate the end of your life, but Amelia shrieks. Joshua curses under his breath and kicks you in the face. You slip into unconsciousness.
